description: Find the game's console variables — the settings behind SetCVar/GetCVar. Covers every CVar the client registers, and for the ones Blizzard's own UI touches, shows how it reads them, where, and what the options screen calls them. Use this before writing SetCVar, or to discover which CVar controls a piece of game behaviour.

query.description: CVar name or fragment, e.g. nameplate, cameraDistance.

usedOnly.description: Only CVars Blizzard's own UI reads or writes — the documented-by-example ones.

name: wow_cvar_search
title: Look up console variables (CVars)
